profile.headline: Engineering @ Oracle
profile.summary:
Senior Software Developer with 12+ years of experience building scalable web applications and modern UX for large enterprise platforms. Leverages JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, GraphQL, and Java to design APIs, modernize data flows, and improve performance and client satisfaction—driving measurable scalability and responsiveness gains. Focused on delivering AI-enabled, user-centric solutions and evolving platform architecture to support future product innovation and operational excellence

Looking to network with people of common interest, especially with engineers and entrepreneurs to gain experience

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed React TypeScript features for the EHRC & AI platform, enhancing user workflows.  
• Implemented Node.js and Java client-server integrations, improving API response reliability.  
• Mentored engineers through code reviews and paired development sessions, elevating implementation quality.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Java · Microservices · JavaScript · Grafana · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · OCI · TypeScript

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: In my role at The Home Depot, I spearheaded the Homepage and PDP teams, focusing on delivering tailored B2B/B2C experiences. This initiative not only increased user engagement but also improved conversion rates significantly. Additionally, I enhanced site scalability and response times, achieving a remarkable 30% boost in performance for our largest application. My contributions were pivotal in supporting the company's commitment to customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Front-End Development · GraphQL · Technical Leadership · Algorithms · Web Technologies · Programming

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I played a key role in enhancing user experience by designing and implementing front-end features for MSP risk tools.  

• Developed AngularJS features that streamlined user workflows and improved usability.  
• Collaborated with various teams to integrate new functionalities seamlessly.  
• Employed D3.js and Ruby on Rails to create robust and interactive applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Technical Leadership · JavaScript · Ruby · Ruby on Rails · D3.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes · Terraform

positions.title: Contract Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed in-house web and mobile features using AngularJS, Java, Ionic, and Salesforce.  
• Enhanced the Touch Point Management System, leading to measurable improvements in user experience.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of new features.  
• Contributed to USAA's mission of providing exceptional financial services to military members and their families.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · JavaScript · Java · D3.js · Node.js · Ionic Framework · AngularJS · Spring Framework
